name: Binance BTC/USDT one-, five-, and fifteen-minute momentum
description: Causal simple basis-point returns of the fresh Binance displayed best-quote midpoint over one-, five-, and fifteen-minute horizons on the one-second midpoint ring. direction_5m is down, flat, or up from the full-precision five-minute return. Any missing or non-ready one-second observation breaks continuity and restarts the fifteen-minute warm-up; the identity is ready only once the ring holds 901 contiguous one-second samples (the longest horizon, 15 minutes). This is a longer-horizon companion to the micro identities and never widens the existing micro_momentum contract (SME contract stability). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Binance inputs and is ready whenever the Binance midpoint ring holds 901 contiguous one-second samples, independently of the other adopted spot venues. The blended btc.external.* reading of the same measurement keeps its every-venue AND-gate and stays the reference layer (ADR 0024). Binance inputs are rights-gated (signals/knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md): the lane is built and tested to the adopted standard, and its runtime refuses to start unless the environment allow-list SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES names binance. E47 (USD quoting): this identity publishes no price-, notional- or quote-denominated field — its outputs are basis-point returns, their root mean square, a ratio, a direction word and a sample count, all scale-free — so nothing is converted, no usdt_usd_rate is published, and it never goes usdt_reference_stale; quote_currency is the constant "usd".
